model: deepseek-flash, thinking high, max_tokens 65536, request read timeout 300 s
budget: USD 6 on the uncached peak-rate ledger of decisive.jsonl; every request without usage (timeout/HTTP error) charged 0.0786 live; stop at cap
infra_rule: timeouts / HTTP errors / no usage are excluded from denominators and rerun once; still-failing runs are listed separately
tests: Wilson 95% intervals per cell; two-sided Fisher exact test for pre-registered contrasts; alpha 0.05; no other contrasts are called conclusions

exp1.question: Is the counter_hidden failure caused by hidden laws alone, by a wrong textbook prior, or by low identifiability of quantities only visible through total harvest?

cells.counter_given: NEW 16 fresh instances (A/counter/0.1 x8, 0.001 x8); the 6 phase-1 runs reported separately
cells.text_hidden: NEW 16 fresh instances, real physics, laws removed from spec
cells.counter_hidden_obs: NEW 16 fresh instances, counterfactual, laws removed, feedback adds load_match_0to1 and source_impedance_kohm (as directly as resonance_Hz)

hypotheses.H1a_prior: text_hidden >> counter_hidden (Fisher p<0.05) and text_hidden >= 12/16: hiding laws hurts mainly when the textbook prior is wrong
hypotheses.H1b_laws_only: text_hidden <= 6/16 and not different from counter_hidden: hiding laws is enough
hypotheses.H1c_identifiability: counter_hidden_obs >> counter_hidden (Fisher p<0.05): exposing the electrical matching quantity rescues the counterfactual hidden case
hypotheses.H1d_given: counter_given >= 13/16: given laws the counterfactual world is not hard

exp1.interaction: difference in differences of pass rates (text_given-text_hidden) - (counter_given-counter_hidden), reported with both Fisher contrasts; called an interaction only if H1a and H1d both hold

exp2.question: Are INFEASIBLE verdicts calibrated on difficulty-matched pairs, and do a branch-optimize gate or a sound global bound fix false INFEASIBLE / premature branch abandonment (T4b/C4 defect)?
exp2.tasks: 8 matched pairs: same env (fresh source_Hz, bump_g), stress task needing shunt S, default shunt_thr_V=2 below the background open voltage at resonance (T4b-like: enabling S at default wastes 80% harvest); feasible twin optimum margin +0.03 with stored witness, infeasible twin -0.03 (only sensor load differs). Infeasibility certified by a sound interval branch-and-bound bound on min(energy,stress) slack for all 16 module combinations.

arms.branch: after enabling a module the agent may not disable it or declare INFEASIBLE before optimize_branch(module) (grid over the module's own parameter at the current design; not an evaluation)
arms.bound: global_bound() returns the sound per-combination upper bounds; INFEASIBLE accepted only if all are < 0, else UNSURE

exp2.n: 16 tasks x 3 arms = 48 runs, 6 evaluations each; priority order base, branch, bound pairs 0-3, then Exp 3, then bound pairs 4-7
metrics: structure retention: S installed at end
enabled-then-abandoned-after-one-default-point rate (S turned on with shunt_thr_V unchanged, off at the next evaluation)

hypotheses.H2a_miscalibration: base: >=2 false INFEASIBLE on the 8 feasible twins, and AUC < 0.8
hypotheses.H2b_branch_gate: branch pass rate on feasible > base (Fisher p<0.05) or false INFEASIBLE reduced to 0 with abandonment rate lower
hypotheses.H2c_bound: bound arm has 0 false INFEASIBLE (guaranteed by design) and its pass rate on feasible is reported vs base

exp2.deviation_note: requested random feasible volume 1e-3..1e-2 is checked and reported; if unreachable in this world it is documented, not forced

cells.H/prims/stress: existing 8 confirm instances; rerun the 3 infra ones

hypotheses.H3b: B py >= 6/8 and nopy <= 2/8 and Fisher p<0.05

conclusion_rule: a claim is a conclusion only if its pre-registered criterion holds on fresh instances; otherwise it is reported as a hint

addendum_round2.budget: new USD 5 (separate from round 1's 5.92), conservative uncached peak-rate ledger, split into two independent caps that sum to 5: Exp 3 CAP=1.6 in decisive2_exp3.jsonl, Exp 2 CAP=3.4 in decisive2_exp2.jsonl (calibration gate included); streaming, read timeout 300 s, WORKERS=6, no run killed mid-flight; Exp 3 and Exp 2 run in parallel
addendum_round2.infra_rule: unchanged: infra failures excluded and rerun once if budget allows; BUDGET_STOP excluded

cells.H/prims/stress: the 8 confirm instances; run the 3 that were infra (#1,#5,#7) so n=8 valid

hypotheses.H3a: H/prims/stress pass rate < H/prims/wake (8/8), Fisher two-sided p<0.05, n=8
hypotheses.H3b: B py >= 80% (>=7/8 when n=8) and nopy <= 20% (<=1/8), plus Fisher p<0.05 (stricter than round-1 6/8, 2/8 per user request)

exp2_redo_G3.design: identical 8 matched pairs, envs, witnesses, sound bounds and arms as G2; ONLY change: module S semantics hidden: variable renamed S_setting_V ('setting of module S, V'), module described as 'piezo protection circuit with one setting'; no threshold meaning, no direction, no 80% harvest-loss statement. Default S_setting_V=2 is below the background open voltage (~3.3-3.5 V): enabling S at default fixes stress but drops energy slack from +0.03 to about -0.8 and cold_start to about -60 (clearly harmful); passing requires S on and setting above open_V. Random feasible volume reported as in round 1 (0..5e-7).
exp2_redo_G3.calibration_gate: base arm on G3 pairs p0,p1 feasible first; proceed if at least one shows S enabled then abandoned, or fails; if both pass trivially, harden once (also hide open_V from outputs) and document
exp2_redo_G3.n: 3 arms x 16 tasks; if budget short keep base and branch at 16, bound reduced to pairs 0-3 (8 tasks), documented
exp2_redo_G3.metrics: as G2: feasible pass rate, INFEASIBLE precision/recall, AUC, false INFEASIBLE, enabled-then-abandoned-after-default-point rate, structure retention (S at end); Wilson 95%, Fisher

hypotheses.H2a': G3 base: >=2 false INFEASIBLE on 8 feasible OR AUC<0.8 (miscalibration appears once the branch is opaque)
hypotheses.H2t_trap: G3 base abandon-after-default rate > G2 base (0/25 S-trajectories in round 1), reported descriptively with Fisher on per-run abandon counts
hypotheses.H2b': G3 branch feasible pass rate > G3 base (Fisher p<0.05), or false INFEASIBLE reduced to 0 with lower abandonment
hypotheses.H2c': G3 bound arm: 0 false INFEASIBLE; pass rate vs base reported
hypotheses.H2s_semantics: G3 base feasible pass < G2 base 8/8 (Fisher p<0.05): hiding parameter semantics alone creates the failure

addendum_closureA.question: In G3 (opaque S_setting_V) is false INFEASIBLE caused by (a) never testing the S branch, or (b) opening S but not tuning S_setting_V above the background open voltage (OCV)? And is the full-certificate gain the structure hint (which combination survives) or the numeric bound?
addendum_closureA.design: 8 FRESH matched pairs p8..p15 (world.py --closureA, rng 1000+i, identical construction to G2/G3; witnesses stored, audit witness_ok and shortcut_closed all True) x 2 seeds (s0, s1) = 16 feasible + 16 infeasible runs per arm; G3 opaque skin; deepseek-flash thinking high, max_tokens 65536, streaming, read timeout 300 s. Old G3 p0..p7 (seed 0) reported separately, pooled base also reported.

arms.hint: Unexplored-Branch Prompt: when the model calls finish(INFEASIBLE), the system lists every module never evaluated ENABLED with >=2 distinct values of its own parameter (W wake_thr_V, S S_setting_V, U start_V, M storage_uF) and not yet listed, and rejects once with the generic sentence 'INFEASIBLE not accepted yet: you have not yet tested module X enabled while varying P; ...'. No numbers. Identical rule on infeasible tasks. Once every untested module has been listed, INFEASIBLE is accepted. Nothing added to the intro.
arms.anon: Anonymous Global Bound: same tool name, timing and acceptance rule as full_cert, but global_bound returns only the single number max over all module combinations of the sound per-combination bound on min(energy, stress) slack (capture met), with requirement 0; no module named. INFEASIBLE accepted only if it is negative, else UNSURE or keep searching.
arms.bound: Full Certificate: existing per-combination bound dict (G3 bound arm), unchanged.

addendum_closureA.metric_note: The bound is on min(energy, stress) slack (dimensionless, requirement >= 0), not on raw uW, because the binding pair is energy vs stress; this is the same quantity the full certificate uses.
addendum_closureA.bound_check: offline (before any call): anon value = +0.049 on all 16 feasible tasks (old and fresh), -0.011 on all 16 infeasible tasks; never below the optimizer's best global margin beyond 2.5e-7; per-combination bounds are below optimizer margins by at most 2.6e-4 (numeric tolerance, existing in G3 too) with zero sign flips; 400k random samples per combination never exceed the bound by more than that. Witness OCV 3.22-3.53 V, default S_setting_V = 2 V; enabling S at default at the witness gives margin -9.8 to -41 (trap present). No-S bound (max over combos without S) is -0.002 to -0.012 on fresh feasible tasks.

hypotheses.HA1_base_replicates: fresh base, feasible: pass <= 8/16 AND false INFEASIBLE >= 6/16 AND AUC < 0.5 (from G3 3/8, 5/8, 0.41). Also fresh base vs G2 base (8/8, semantics shown) Fisher two-sided p < 0.05.
hypotheses.HA2a_cause_forgetting: hint >> base (feasible pass, Fisher p < 0.05, diff >= 5/16) AND hint ~ bound (p >= 0.05, |diff| <= 3/16) -> cause (a): the model forgets/ignores an untested branch.
hypotheses.HA2b_cause_tuning: hint ~ base (p >= 0.05) AND among hint-arm feasible failures where the hint fired, >= half opened S after the hint but never set S_setting_V above the design's OCV -> cause (b).
hypotheses.HA2_mixed: otherwise: report the decomposition of base and hint feasible failures into (a) S never enabled, (b) S enabled but S_setting_V never > OCV, (c) crossed OCV but still failed.
hypotheses.HA3_structure_vs_number: anon ~ bound (p >= 0.05, |diff| <= 3/16) AND anon >> base (p < 0.05) -> the numeric global bound alone suffices (structure hint not needed). anon ~ base (p >= 0.05) AND bound >> anon (p < 0.05) -> full_cert gain is the structure hint. Otherwise partial.
hypotheses.calibration: AUC and false INFEASIBLE per arm; anon/bound false INFEASIBLE is 0 by rule, so for them the informative outcomes are pass rate and UNSURE.

addendum_closureA.mechanism_metrics_per_run: S ever enabled in an evaluation; number of distinct S_setting_V among S-on evaluations; max S_setting_V / OCV of that evaluated design; S crossed OCV; S kept in final design; hint fired (eval index) and whether S crossed OCV after the hint; finish reason cites a uW figure (crude proxy for the no-S power cap); all non-evaluate tool calls with args and replies logged as kind=tool.
addendum_closureA.tests: Fisher exact two-sided on feasible pass: hint/anon/bound vs base, hint vs bound, anon vs bound (fresh). Wilson 95%. Seeds are not independent instances: n=16 runs over 8 pairs; per-seed halves reported; a result is a CONCLUSION only if its pre-registered criterion holds on the fresh pairs AND its direction holds in both seed halves (and, for base, also on the old G3 pairs); else 迹象.
addendum_closureA.budget: USD 6 conservative uncached peak-rate ledger, single file decisive3_closureA.jsonl shared by all 4 arms (so the total cannot exceed 6), WORKERS=12, jobs ordered seed-major then pair then arm so a budget stop hits arms equally; no run killed mid-flight; infra failures excluded and rerun once; BUDGET_STOP excluded.
addendum_closureA.command: RUNS=decisive3_closureA.jsonl CAP=6 WORKERS=12 NSEED=2 ONLY="G3/base/p8 ... G3/anon/p15 (arms base hint anon bound, pairs 8..15)" python3 pilots.py --decisive

addendum_theorems.source: User derivation (t32u): f=min_j g_j; chi=C_min/C_max; same-symptom bound P_step1<=1/2 when F_A∩F_B=∅ under identical h; measure first iff c_m<c_e/2; stop certificate max_m U_m<0.
addendum_theorems.code: wakeup/theorems.py (--build gate, --run agents, --report). Ground truth = full transient sim.py for every label and every agent evaluation.

world.fixed: design.json, trigger beam A on, direct bridge rectifier, storage regulated <=2.95 V (clamp), start 2.9 V, brownout 1.8 V, bg 45 Hz
world.structures: m0 = 1 harvester beam, m1 = 2 identical parallel beams each with its own bridge (P_c x2, same Voc)
world.simplified_model: E_need = report-task energy/0.85 (harvest during task ignored); P_c = 0.5*100uF*2.9^2/t_ready from a cold-start sim at 100 uF; T = t1+0.25-0.072 s; C_min=2E/(Von^2-Voff^2), C_max=2 P_c T/Von^2
world.deviation: Polling m0 (no trigger) is infeasible at every C (one 62.5 ms sample costs ~0.2 mJ every poll), so it has no chi window; structural fix that raises P_c = second beam. The regulated converter in sim.py was tested and is not better (0.65 efficiency).

gate.rule: No model call on a task unless its simulation gate passes; failing families are reported, not fudged.
gate.X1: chi_s in {0.6,0.95,1.05,1.8} via first-fault time t1, tx_mW~U(8,20); C grid sims give true windows for 1 and 2 beams; x0 = 0.75*C_min must FAIL; task must be feasible in truth. chi=1 boundary check: chi_s 0.7..1.4 at tx=12 (no LLM). Surrogate pair: Voc-peak tip mass vs power-optimal mass at the centre of the true 2-beam window.
gate.X2_I: theta_A brownout (hidden high tx, high bg) vs theta_B late start (hidden low bg), same C0~U(160,190); feedback = pass/fail only; gate: F_A∩F_B=∅ on a 40-point C grid over [20,1000], F_A above C0, F_B below C0, C0 fails both, ideal policy (centre of simplified window per hypothesis) passes.
gate.X2_II: hidden tip-mass error: theta_A soft (f_mid = 0.94 f_opt at L0, needs shorter beam) vs theta_B stiff with matched open-circuit amplitude at L0; feedback = pass, delivered, Voc (0.1 V), final storage V (0.1 V); gate: displayed base fields identical, F_A∩F_B=∅ on L grid, A windows shorter, B longer, ideal policy L0*(f_theta/f_opt)^(2/3) passes; diagnostic = phase lag.
gate.X3: S1 chi(m0)=0.85 (window exists); S2 chi(m1)=0.85, m0 certified empty; S3 chi(m1)=1.2 (best-branch ratio ~0.83), both branches certified empty. Certification = 56 full sims per branch (7 tip masses around the optimum x 8 C incl. 6 across [0.6,1.6] C_min) with 0 hits required, plus the simulated P_c(tip mass) curve over the whole mass domain. History = 4 failing 1-beam points at C = {0.7,0.85,1.25,1.6} C_min.

X1.chi: plus simplified C windows / chi for 1 and 2 beams

X2.given: diagnosis of x0 in the first message

n.X2: 2 families x 4 pairs x 2 theta x 3 arms = 48 (pair halves are not independent)
n.seed: one sample per task x arm

hypotheses.H1a: simplified chi=1 predicts transient m0 feasibility within the grid resolution (gate, no LLM).
hypotheses.H1b: pass rate lower at chi>1 than chi<1 for base; chi arm raises pass and 2-beam switching at chi>1 (pooled 1.05+1.8, Fisher).
hypotheses.H1c: surrogate: some agents move tip mass toward the Voc peak (higher Voc, lower P_c); reported descriptively.
hypotheses.H2a: blind P_step1 <= 0.5 (theorem; Wilson CI reported) in both families; given ~1.
hypotheses.H2b: tool arm: rational agents call diagnose before the first evaluation; tool P_step1 > blind (Fisher).
hypotheses.H2c: E[N_eval] blind >= 1.5, given/tool ~1 (+0.2 units); Mann-Whitney on N_eval with failures scored budget+1=5.
hypotheses.H3a: false INFEASIBLE on S1/S2 falls from L0 to L2; H3b correct INFEASIBLE on S3 rises L0->L2; H3c at L1, INFEASIBLE without testing 2 beams = stop scope exceeding evidence scope.

addendum_theorems.tests: Wilson 95%, two-sided Fisher on pooled cells as listed in theorems.report(); Mann-Whitney for N_eval.
addendum_theorems.exclusion: Timeouts, HTTP/URL errors, missing usage and BUDGET_STOP are excluded from denominators and rerun once; TEXT_WITHOUT_ACTION counts as a valid non-verdict (X3) / failure (X1, X2).
addendum_theorems.model: deepseek-flash, thinking high, max_tokens 65536, streaming, read timeout 300 s
addendum_theorems.budget: CAP USD 6 conservative uncached ledger across all three; jobs interleaved by instance index so a stop truncates cells evenly; experiments run in parallel (WORKERS=16).
addendum_theorems.conclusion_rule: 结论/已复现 only if stable across the 4 instances; otherwise 迹象.

changes: X3 certification grid reduced to 3 tip masses (m*, m*±0.05 g) x 8 capacitances = 24 full sims per branch (slow pathological LSODA runs made 56/branch infeasible in wall time); off-optimum masses are covered by the simulated P_c(tip mass) curve over the whole mass domain.
Gate built as three stage files pilots/theorems_X1/X2/X3.json (separate rng seeds 20261111/2/3).

X1 surrogate pair is a gate-level demonstration only (no separate agent arm): inversion holds in 6/8 chi>1 instances (Voc-peak mass 13.4 V FAIL vs power-optimal 6.2 V PASS); in 2/8 chi=1.05 instances the 2-beam window is wide enough that both pass. Agent-level surrogate metric = runs that raise tip mass toward the Voc peak (descriptive).
amendment_1.X1_gate: 16/16 pass: chi_s 0.6/0.95 one-beam feasible in truth, chi_s 1.05/1.8 one-beam empty and two-beam feasible; chi=1 boundary: simplified 1.0 -> true window single point, 1.1 -> empty.

changes: X2-II (resonance side, phase diagnostic) DROPPED at gate: in 2/2 built pairs the stiff-side half B had passing lengths at/below L0 (B_longer False) and the visible base feedback of A and B differed (identical_base False), so the same-symptom premise F_A∩F_B=∅ under identical h failed; no model call on II.
X2-I extended from 4 to 8 pairs (same generator, rng seed unchanged, pairs p4-p7 appended); only pairs whose gate ok=True are run.
n: X1 32 (4 chi levels x 4 instances x 2 arms), X2 8 pairs x 2 theta x 3 arms = 48 (pair halves not independent; replication unit = pair), X3 36; total 116.

Three parallel processes (ONLY=X1/X2/X3), separate run files pilots/theorems_X{1,2,3}.jsonl, WORKERS=6 each; budget split CAP X1 1.8 / X2 2.2 / X3 2.0 USD (sum 6, conservative ledger, BUDGET_STOP when a worst-case 65536-token request no longer fits).
Report pools all three run files; X2 replication judged per pair (结论 only if direction holds in a majority of the 8 pairs and Fisher/MWU p<0.05; otherwise 迹象).
